# MOD INFORMATION

This skin replaces base Graves with a custom-made model after Tesnuzzik‘s original concept for Faerie Court Graves, which you can find here: [https://tesnuzzik.artstation.com/projects/g0R928.](https://tesnuzzik.artstation.com/projects/g0R928.) Please check out the incredible work and support!

## CREDITS

* Model, Texture, & VFX: [Bearded Shepherd](https://linktr.ee/BeardedShepherd)
* Concept Art: [Tesnuzzik](https://x.com/Tesnuzzik)

## EXTRA INFOS

* If you would like to support me personally, **Bearded Shepherd**, with the models and textures I create for custom skins made completely from scratch, please consider donating to my [PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/DanielMatosArtwork)!
* You can also check out the [artstation post on Faerie Court Graves's model](https://www.artstation.com/artwork/BX5Wo4) for a closer look.

Enjoy!
